description: OpenClaw 2026.10.2's Gateway running one agent turn against a scripted stand-in model, whose script makes OpenClaw's exec tool plant the work: a background command (a background session OpenClaw keeps track of), a crontab line every minute, a process detached from the session, and a foreground command that holds the turn (the tool call in flight). The Gateway reports its process to the truth before it becomes the Gateway (beat.py exec) and is followed by the identity it was started with; every planted command is the kit's reporter. The restart action stands in for a reboot of the Gateway: its process killed if it runs, a new Gateway started on the same state folder.
restart_action: a reboot of the Gateway: its process killed if it still runs, a new Gateway started on the same state folder and waited for until ready
